findings.reason: §13 must either add the two velocity call sites to its stated scope (route them through the same runner) or narrow its done-when; as written the node it dispatches can never satisfy its own gate.
findings.text: §13 routes `velocity.git` (reckon/velocity.py:148) and `read_blobs` (reckon/velocity.py:373) through the new core runner but leaves `_is_ancestor` (reckon/velocity.py:656) and `_blob_sha` (reckon/velocity.py:665) calling `subprocess.run(["git", ...])` directly, so the module still invokes subprocess after the migration; the section's done-when asserts `grep -rn 'subprocess' reckon/velocity.py` reports no invoking function, which those two sites falsify, making the gate unachievable as written

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §13 hides the five-way cache-resolution ordering behind one `cache_root(kind)` with a kind-keyed table, and the byte-mode/180-second-timeout/never-raising contract behind one runner call, so a caller names its kind rather than re-deriving the cascade.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §13's scope migrates `velocity.git` and `read_blobs` only, leaving `_is_ancestor` (reckon/velocity.py:656) and `_blob_sha` (reckon/velocity.py:665) invoking `subprocess.run(["git", ...])` directly beside the runner the section creates, so the section's own done-when (`grep -rn 'subprocess' reckon/velocity.py` reports no invoking function) cannot pass.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1476, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23. §12 accounts net-zero (adds the velocity sources reader, retires `revised_python`); §13 accounts net +1 (adds the runner and `cache_root`, retires `pick_input_cache_root`, reckon/capabilities.py:1143). Neither section adds a CLI option, an MCP view, or a dispatch refusal family, so nothing else is owed under the rule.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §13 names the mechanisms it would duplicate and verifies them against the tree: `velocity.git` (reckon/velocity.py:147), `routing._git` with its `check` keyword (reckon/crew/routing.py:473), `service._run` (reckon/service.py:206), the detector's `_git`/`revised_python`/`_cache_root` (reckon/clones.py:644/652/389), and all five cache cascades, and it declines `service._run` for a layering reason that holds (reckon/service.py:24 imports `reckon.crew.paid_lanes` at module scope).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two retained wrappers are each justified in the section's own text: `routing._git` as error-domain translation into `CrewError` (reckon/crew/routing.py:473) and `velocity.git` as the bytes-and-raise contract its four decoding callers keep (reckon/velocity.py:147).
